svg.title: Agent Two Hand HandOff
svg.desc: A payment moves from a creator-signed mandate, through agents that only propose, a plain-code policy engine that blocks an injected "pay $5,000" and uses the $40 rate-card amount, PayPal Payouts in the sandbox, and into signed receipts sealed by an Ed25519 and ML-DSA-65 checkpoint.
